evidence: Cic. Or. 138: hominum sermōnēs mōrēsque (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Also of drawing, as of figures in the sand (Cic. Rep. 1.17, Lewis & Short). Manuscripts often confuse it with discrībō, distribute (Lewis & Short).

evidence: Cic. Rosc. Am. 74: vītam hujusce (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: tell in full, describe point by point
evidence: Ter. Ad. 364: omnem rem … ēnarrāmus ōrdine
Cic. Inv. 2.18: nōminis brevis et aperta dēscrīptiō (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: nōn potuit pictor rēctius dēscrībere ejus fōrmam
phrases.english: a painter couldn’t have described his looks more exactly

phrases.latin: omnem rem modo senī, quō pactō sē habēret, ēnarrāmus ōrdine
phrases.english: we have just told the old man the whole business, how it stood, from start to finish
